digest.component_or_area: Repository-wide module-size headroom and code health
propositions: 46 files in src/rebar exceed 700 LOC, with 7 at 796-800 LOC, exhausting module-size headroom across the repository

pass1.py (800 LOC) contains four fused concerns: G3/G4 container pairing, pass1 driver, ISF/context builders, and usage aggregation; extracting the container stage to new container_stage.py module and relocating _submit_ctx to generation.py reduces pass1.py to 534 LOC

push.py (799 LOC) contains a stash/recovery cluster of eight functions forming a single subtree with one external call site; extracting this cluster plus _PUSH_MERGE_LOCK_TIMEOUT to new push_recovery.py (366 LOC) using core-parameter late-binding pattern avoids monkeypatch cycles while reducing push.py to 524 LOC

module_size_distribution.near_cap_count field computes files within 10% of the locked cap but was not surfaced; appending a non-blocking ::warning:: pass to the Module-size CI gate in _build-and-test.yml emits warnings for all 37+ in-band files and always exits 0

_submit_ctx must move to generation.py because the worker it launches calls generation.review_cancelled(), whose _CANCEL_SCOPE ContextVar is defined in generation.py and must be captured by copy_context() at call time

all re-exported module symbols and patch sites in orchestrator.py, provider_parity.py, push_state.py, and _bridge_runner.py remain byte-unchanged; Changes 1 and 2 edit zero test files and maintain test-count parity against parent commits
